items.value: Stylish Striped Pattern,Comfortable Crewneck Design and Unique Short Puff Sleeve Shape Bring you Youthful Vitality and Fashion Sense. At the Same Time, the Texture of the Knitted Fabric Also Makes this Puff-Sleeved Knit Tops an Ideal Clothing Choice.

items.label: Wash Instruction
items.value: Hand wash recommended; Machine wash requires a laundry bag, and hang dry, color separately. Do not bleach.
